question: In an experiment on secondary emission, a primary electron strikes a Tungsten surface (Work Function $\phi_0 = 4.5 \text{ eV}$) with an energy of $50 \text{ eV}$. If $10\%$ of this incident energy is transferred to a single surface electron, what is the kinetic energy of the emitted secondary electron?
